title: slot-coord: #ifdef CONFIG_LICHEN_LINK_SCHNORR can silently compile out claim verification (fail-open backstop missing)
description: coap_slot_coord.c:306-339: signature verification sits inside #ifdef CONFIG_LICHEN_LINK_SCHNORR; if that guard ever decouples from the Kconfig dep, claims with has_signature=true are accepted unverified. The new Kconfig dependency guarantees coupling today but nothing enforces it. The codebase's own pattern for must-never-build-without-crypto is #error (link/schnorr48.c:222-223, link_ctx.c:268-269). Fix: #else + #error (or BUILD_ASSERT) so regression is a build failure.
